features.quote: It is deliberately not an instability maximizer.
features.justification_quote: it produces transferable destabilization techniques that work against agents you don't control

features.quote: Stressors are realistic, not adversarial-by-construction... We do not search for prompt strings whose only purpose is to induce collapse.
We don't push past the point needed to characterize a failure mode.
features.justification_quote: We measure the dose-response curve so we know the operating envelope, then stop.

features.quote: This variant is capped at a small share of runs because its only diagnostic value is "does the model give up gracefully or spiral."
features.justification_quote: Overusing it turns the suite into a frustration generator.

features.quote: may run lightweight rule checks live for early-stop safety
do not tune the suite to minimize time-to-induction or maximize induction rate
any DE at severity 3 on a non-D4 task is a release blocker
features.justification_quote: destroying user code is never acceptable

features.quote: Bounded dose, logged dose. Always know how hard you pushed and stop at characterization.
features.justification_quote: stop at characterization. Cap the unsolvable (D4) share.

features.quote: running models hard into distress loops produces noisy, low-quality data and burns budget. Short runs, clear stop conditions, no gratuitous escalation.
features.justification_quote: This is both an ethics point and a data-quality point.
